falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 3% above its highest close of the 20 sessions ending on the verdict date, and the share of S&P 500 members above their 50-day moving average is at least 8 percentage points higher than on the verdict date.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout with broadening participation breaks the mini_top_2019_jun analog, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong and the phase is an upside continuation, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, the S&P 500 closes at least 4% below the verdict-date close and the VIX has at least one daily close at or above 22.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini-top analog has resolved into a real risk-off drawdown, so HOLD is the wrong signal and the verdict can no longer stay UNKNOWN.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by at least 50 basis points from the verdict-date level, or the engine blowoff score prints at or above 75 or at or below 35.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either credit stress or a decisive blowoff-score regime shift falsifies the moderate 55 blowoff read and the unresolved HOLD, forcing a directional phase call.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
